中央の文字に触れると、
{09:08}『守護者を倒し力を示せ』{09:01}
という思念が頭に直接響いてくる。
strings.en:
{1c:63}A stone gate blocks the way. When you
touch the letters at its center, a
thought-form echoes directly in your
head: {09:08}'Slay the guardian and show thy{1a}strength.'{09:01}
strings.tl: A stone gate blocks the way. When you touch the letters at its center, a thought-form echoes directly in your head: [1]'Slay the guardian and show thy strength.'[2]

strings.jp:
{1c:63}魔{e0c1}陣で道が{e086}{e087}されている。
{e0bd}れると『我は{e08a}の{e086}{e087}なり。
道を求めし者よ、{e08a}の力を示せ』
という思念が頭に直接響いてくる。

触れると『我は炎の封印なり。
道を求めし者よ、炎の力を示せ』
という思念が頭に直接響いてくる。
strings.en:
{1c:63}A magic circle seals the way. When you
touch it, a thought-form echoes directly
in your head: 'I am the seal of fire.
Seeker of the way, show thy power of{1a}fire.'
strings.tl: A magic circle seals the way. When you touch it, a thought-form echoes directly in your head: 'I am the seal of fire. Seeker of the way, show thy power of fire.'
